subject: 970 Fellsway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board reviewed civil engineering, landscape design, and a traffic peer review for a proposed 289-unit residential development at 970 Fellsway. The hearing was continued to April 23 to allow for a formal response to the traffic study findings and pending civil engineering comments.

items.title: 970 Fellsway (Case 40B-2023-01)
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for a proposed 289-unit 40B multifamily development to review civil engineering, landscape architecture, and a traffic impact peer review. The board discussed concerns regarding traffic safety at local intersections, site circulation on Myrtle Street, and the adequacy of electric vehicle charging infrastructure. Continued to April 23.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Minutes
items.summary: Scheduled a procedural special meeting for the Mystic Avenue 40B remand for April 30 and approved the meeting minutes for January 11 and February 15, 2024.
